summary: Luke Badiali reviewed Meridian's CRM and reporting with Chris and Leanne. The CRM is used mainly as a contact list and forecasting is done in a spreadsheet. We agreed to configure the CRM around the five stages from week 5 and to run a weekly forecast.

discussion.keyPoints: Meridian uses HubSpot Starter. Only Leanne updates it; partners keep notes in email. Chris admitted he has not logged in for months.
Around 40% of contacts have no company or PE owner recorded, which makes the PE relationship mapping impossible.
Forecast is a monthly spreadsheet built by Leanne from conversations with partners, with no probability weighting.

recommendations.recommendation: Upgrade to HubSpot Sales Professional for 6 seats and configure the five agreed stages.
Add a mandatory PE owner field on every company record and clean the existing 40% gap by end of next month.
Run a weekly 30-minute forecast call on Mondays using stage-weighted probabilities.
Build one dashboard showing pipeline by PE house, so concentration risk is visible.

actions.action: Get a quote for HubSpot Sales Professional for 6 seats
Chair the first Monday forecast call

nextFocus: Align marketing campaigns with the operating partner proposition.
nextPreparation: Leanne to collect all marketing content produced in the last year.

tests.question: What did we agree about forecasting?
What field did we agree to make mandatory?
